ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Biteflow uses the camera to photograph food and scan product barcodes.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Biteflow reads the photo you choose to suggest a food or read a barcode.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Biteflow uses the microphone only when you choose to dictate food on this device.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Biteflow converts your food description to editable text on this device.
ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: BiteFlow reads only the weight and step data you choose to import into your private journal.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: BiteFlow writes your confirmed nutrition and water entries only when you enable sync.
